scenarios.name: drop_latest_records
scenarios.description: Dropped ~20% of latest records to simulate stale ingestion & missing documents.

scenarios.name: blank_summary
scenarios.description: Erased summaries on records to trigger schema length validation failure.

scenarios.name: inject_noise
scenarios.description: Injected random corruption tokens to degrade retrieval precision and Token F1.

scenarios.name: truncate_title
scenarios.description: Truncated paper titles to fewer than 8 characters.

scenarios.name: stale_date
scenarios.description: Shifted publication dates back by 365 days (age_days > 180) to violate Freshness SLA.

scenarios.name: duplicate_rows
scenarios.description: Appended duplicate rows to cause ghost vectors and unique ID constraint violations.
